g.text: Video Game Matchmaking - complete class structure
Repeated class names refer to the same objects. Constructor wiring in Main is omitted; runtime relations are shown.
Solid arrow: stored reference. Dashed arrow: use or creation.

g.text: inspect: combines persisted states into one result.
compensate: delegates the reverse sequence to the common facade.
RuntimeException is built into Java; it is not a project source file.

g.text: Rules and services throw StageRejected; the facade catches it.
The triangle points to the parent class (extends).
The subsystem does not import or call either of the other two.

g.text: Solid = stored reference; dashed = dependency; hollow triangle = inheritance. + public; - private. JSON files are storage, not classes.
